title: Platōn: Apologia
subtitle: Verba authentica: initium ōrātiōnis Sōcraticae (17a) et sententia cēlēberrima “vīta īnexāmināta” (38a) — cum contextū historicō et philosophicō.
objectives: Legere duo passūs authenticōs (nōn adaptātōs) ex Apologiā Sōcratis Platōnis
Situāre textum historicē: iūdicium Sōcratis Athēnīs, 399 a.C., accūsātiōnēs impietātis et corruptiōnis iuventūtis
Analyzāre syntaxem passūs initiālis: ōrātiō oblīqua implicita, ōrdō verbōrum ēmphaticus (Gradū VI)
Memoriae mandāre sententiam “ἀνεξέταστος βίος οὐ βιωτὸς ἀνθρώπῳ” ut summam philosophiae Sōcraticae

content.intro: Duo passūs sequentēs sunt authenticī — verba ipsa Platōnis, ex dialogō Apologia Sōcratis ("Dēfēnsiō Sōcratis"), relātiōne (fortasse partim litterāria, nōn stenographica) ōrātiōnis quam Sōcratēs habuit sē dēfendēns contrā accūsātiōnēs impietātis (ἀσέβεια) et corruptiōnis iuventūtis Athēniēnsis, annō 399 a.C. — iūdicium quod fīnīvit morte Sōcratis.
content.explanation: Prīmus passus est incipit ipsīus ōrātiōnis (17a): Sōcratēs incohat notandō sē nescīre quālem impressiōnem accūsātōrēs suī iam fēcērunt in animīs iūdicum. Secundus passus (38a), prope fīnem, post damnātiōnem, continet fortasse sententiam maximē cēlēbrem tōtīus corporis Platōnici: dēfīnītiōnem vītae philosophicae ipsīus.

rules.heading: Textus I: Apologia 17a (Initium)
rules.body:
Ὅτι μὲν ὑμεῖς, ὦ ἄνδρες Ἀθηναῖοι, πεπόνθατε ὑπὸ τῶν ἐμῶν κατηγόρων, οὐκ οἶδα.

Versiō Latīna: "Quid vōs, ō virī Athēniēnsēs, ab accūsātōribus meīs passī sītis, nesciō."

Commentārius: ὅτι...πεπόνθατε — ōrātiō oblīqua implicita (Gradū VI): ὅτι hīc fūnctiōnat quasi "quid" (nōn simplex "quod"), introducēns clausulam obiectī verbī οἶδα. πεπόνθατε — perfectum āctīvum (Gradū IV) verbī πάσχω ("patior"; fōrmae prīncipālēs: πάσχω, πείσομαι, ἔπαθον, πέπονθα — memorandae sīgillātim, sīcut cēterae verba irregulāria). Nōtā ōrdinem ēmphaticum: ὅτι...πεπόνθατε praeposita ante οὐκ οἶδα, Gradū VI (ēmphasis per positiōnem).

rules.heading: Textus II: Apologia 38a (“Vīta Īnexāmināta”)
rules.body:
Ὁ δὲ ἀνεξέταστος βίος οὐ βιωτὸς ἀνθρώπῳ.

Versiō Latīna: "Vīta autem īnexāmināta nōn est vīvenda hominī." (Trāditiō vulgāta: "vīta non exāmināta nōn est digna quae vīvātur.")

Commentārius: ἀνεξέταστος — adiectīvum duārum terminātiōnum (Gradū III), α- prīvātīvum + thema verbī ἐξετάζω ("exāminō"). βιωτός — adiectīvum verbāle in -τός (Gradū VI!): "vīvibilis, digna quae vīvātur" — EXEMPLUM PERFECTUM patrōnī iam discitī, hīc vīsum in āctū authenticō. ἀνθρώπῳ — datīvus (Gradū I-II), "prō homine" (datīvus commodī/respectūs implicitus).

examples: οὐκ οἶδα. — Nesciō. (verbum frequentissimum, Gradū I passim)
ὦ ἄνδρες Ἀθηναῖοι. — Ō virī Athēniēnsēs! (vocātīvus, fōrmula ōrātōria standard apud Platōnem/Dēmosthenem)
ὁ ἀνεξέταστος βίος — vīta īnexāmināta (adiectīvum classis alterīus, Gradū III, cum α- prīvātīvō)
οὐ βιωτὸς ἀνθρώπῳ — nōn vīvibilis hominī (adiectīvum verbāle -τός + datīvus, Gradū VI)

commonMistakes.wrong: Trānsferre ὅτι in prīmō passū sīcut “quia/quod” causāle, prōdūcendō sēnsum incohaerentem.
commonMistakes.right: Recognōscere ὅτι hīc introducit clausulam obiectī (“quid”), post οἶδα (verbum sciendī) — ōrātiō oblīqua implicita, Gradū VI.
commonMistakes.why: Ambiguitās ὅτι (causāle vs. oblīquum) est exemplum reāle iam praevīsum Gradū VI, hīc applicandum ad textum authenticum.

commonMistakes.wrong: Crēdere “vīta īnexāmināta” significāre “vīta sine philosophiā academicā formālī”, interpretātiōne anachronisticā.
commonMistakes.right: Interpretārī “exāminātiōnem” (ἐξέτασις) in sēnsū Sōcraticō: quaestiōnem cōnstantem propriōrum crēditōrum/āctiōnum/valōrum, methodus elenchī (Gradū VI) applicāta ad sē ipsum.
commonMistakes.why: Contextus philosophicus authenticus (methodus Sōcratica, iam vīsa in dialogō adaptātō Gradūs VI) ēvītat interpretātiōnem anachronisticam.

commonMistakes.wrong: Suppōnere Apologiam esse relātiōnem stenographicam exāctam verbōrum Sōcratis, sine ūllā mediātiōne litterāria Platōnis.
commonMistakes.right: Recognōscere Apologia est OPUS PLATŌNIS (nōn Sōcratis ipsīus, quī nihil scrīpsit), probābiliter combīnāns memoriam et compositiōnem litterāriam — quaestiō historiographica genuīna inter studiōsōs.
commonMistakes.why: Honestās intellectuālis requīrit distinguere “verba authentica Platōnis dē Sōcrate” ā “verba stenographica Sōcratis ipsīus” — discrīmen subtīlis sed significāns.

items.prompt: Quid significat ὅτι in “ὅτι μὲν ὑμεῖς... πεπόνθατε... οὐκ οἶδα”?
items.explanation: Ὅτι hīc introducit obiectum verbī οἶδα, fūnctiōne “quid”.

items.prompt: Quae sunt fōrmae prīncipālēs verbī πάσχω?
Quandō et ubi factum est iūdicium Sōcratis?
items.explanation: Contextus historicus reālis, distīnctus ā fictiōne litterāriā compositiōnis ipsīus.

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: “Ἀνεξέταστος” continet α- prīvātīvum, negāns sēnsum radīcis “exāminātiōnis”.
Apologia est textus quem Sōcratēs ipse scrīpsit.
items.explanation: Falsum: Sōcratēs nihil scrīpsit; Apologia est opus Platōnis.

items.statement: “Ὁ ἀνεξέταστος βίος οὐ βιωτὸς ἀνθρώπῳ” est ūna ex sententiīs maximē citātīs tōtīus philosophiae antīquae.
Iūdicium Sōcratis ēvēnit propter accūsātiōnēs impietātis et corruptiōnis iuventūtis.

summary: Apologia 17a: “Ὅτι μὲν ὑμεῖς, ὦ ἄνδρες Ἀθηναῖοι, πεπόνθατε ὑπὸ τῶν ἐμῶν κατηγόρων, οὐκ οἶδα.” — ὅτι oblīquum, πεπόνθατε perfectum irregulāre.
Apologia 38a: “Ὁ δὲ ἀνεξέταστος βίος οὐ βιωτὸς ἀνθρώπῳ.” — sententia cēleberrima, exemplum -τός (Gradū VI) in āctū.
Contextus: iūdicium Sōcratis, Athēnīs, 399 a.C.; Apologia est opus Platōnis, nōn transcrīptiō stenographica.
Ambō passūs applicant grammaticam integram Gradūum I-VI (ōrātiō oblīqua, adiectīva verbālia, ōrdō ēmphaticus) ad verba authentica.
